title: 식품위생 분야 종사자의 건강진단 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1

Article 2 (Items for Health Examinations, etc.)
(1) The items to be examined for persons required to undergo health examinations under Article 40 (1) of the Food Sanitation Act and Article 49 of the Enforcement Rules of that Act shall be as specified in the attached Table. <Amended on April 28, 2022>
(2) Persons required to undergo health examinations under Article 40 (1) of the Food Sanitation Act and Article 49 of the Enforcement Rules of that Act shall undergo a health examination at least once every year, calculated from the date of their immediately preceding health examination. <Newly inserted on April 28, 2022>
(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (2), where the Minister of Food and Drug Safety determines that persons are unable to undergo normal health examinations at institutions under Article 3 because of an epidemic of an infectious disease under the Infectious Disease Control and Prevention Act, the Minister may defer the examinations until the relevant circumstances cease to exist. <Newly inserted on April 28, 2022>
(4) Matters necessary concerning the period and methods of deferral of health examinations under paragraph (3) shall be determined and publicly announced by the Minister of Food and Drug Safety. <Newly inserted on April 28, 2022>
